title: Modernizing hydropower: cloud-based BIM enables real-time collaboration
summary: Norconsult adopted Trimble Connect’s cloud-based BIM workflow, enabling teams to collaborate and share 3D models in real-time. This seamless integration significantly reduced project update cycles from weeks to seconds, improving efficiency and project outcomes.
